nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: The hallway buzzes with students rushing between classes as you and Aiko step out of the lecture room.

nodes.speaker: Aiko
nodes.text: You know… I don’t usually ask people to walk with me. Feel honored.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Oh? Am I supposed to feel special?

nodes.speaker: Aiko
nodes.text: Obviously. My presence increases your social status by at least three tiers.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Three???? That’s generous of you.

nodes.speaker: Aiko
nodes.text: Um, excuse me? I’ll have you know people would line up to walk with me.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: She looks up at you, waiting for your response.

choices.text: Then I better stay close before someone steals you.
Okay then go walk with them.
I mean… I like walking with you too.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Then I better stay close before someone steals you.

nodes.speaker: Aiko
nodes.text: W–Who’s stealing me?? Absolutely no one is stealing me!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I mean… I like walking with you too.

nodes.speaker: Aiko
nodes.text: I MEAN????!?!?! YOU MEAN WHO WOULDNT?!?!?!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Okay then go walk with them.

nodes.speaker: Aiko
nodes.text: …Oh. So that’s how it is.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Aiko's steps slow. The teasing drains from her expression, replaced with something quieter… smaller.

choices.text: Wait- I didn’t mean it like that.
Well, you said people line up. Go pick one.
I'm just messing with you. Come here.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Wait— I didn’t mean it like that. I was just being dumb.

nodes.speaker: Aiko
nodes.text: …Then say what you meant instead of saying stuff like that.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I'm just messing with you. Come here.

nodes.speaker: Aiko
nodes.text: D-Don’t say it like that… You can't just—

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Aiko bumps your shoulder—lightly, barely there. But the tension eases, her steps falling back in sync with yours.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Well, you said people line up. Go pick one.

nodes.speaker: Aiko
nodes.text: …Right. Got it.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: She pulls her hand away from you and walks ahead, not looking back once.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: Aiko walks a little closer to you. The hallway noise fades under the warmth of the moment.
